narrationTexts: Fix both call sites to match the new options shape.
finalText:
**Build's clean.** Two real bugs, not noise.

`options.retries` in [options.js:7](src/core/options.js:7) didn't match the bundler's new `retryCount` shape, so it threw on `undefined.toFixed`. Fixed to read `retryCount`.

`isBackoffEnabled` in [retryPolicy.js:8](src/net/retryPolicy.js:8) threw on `undefined` flags instead of treating them as `false`, the new loader's default. Added that case.

Build now exits 0 with 8 warnings, all deprecation noise, 0 errors.

Next: nothing. Build's green.
